description: 数据资源库宽表 NL2SQL 评测集（2026-08-23 建 10 用例；2026-08-29 P3-2 扩容至 54 用例，对齐六类分层）。fct_jc_main_biz_stat（94列，BBRQ 报告日期）+ fct_jc_financial_stat（204列，SJRQ 数据日期）均为月末快照宽表。红线：R1 必须锁最新快照期（主营表 BBRQ/财务表 SJRQ 的 MAX 子查询，子查询内也要 BB='1'）；R2 BB='1' 核算版防分成版重复；R3 项目数用 COUNT(DISTINCT XMBH)；R4 财务指标走财务表。multi_dim=多维度分组（宽表无多表 JOIN，以双维度 GROUP BY 对齐主集 join 层）。clarify/refuse 类 goldenSql 仅占位不执行。

cases.question: 数据资源库的累计投放金额是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(LJTFJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1')

cases.question: 目前项目总数是多少个？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT XMBH) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1')

cases.question: 各机构本年投放金额排名前十的是哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT JGMC, SUM(BNTFJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY JGMC ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 逾期金额合计是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(YQJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SFYQ = '是' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1')

cases.question: 各业务分类的成本余额分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT YWFL, SUM(CBEY) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY YWFL

cases.question: 当年投资收益是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(DNTZSY) AS v FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1')

cases.question: 最新两期的累计投放金额分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT BBRQ, SUM(LJTFJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ IN (SELECT BBRQ FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BBRQ FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' ORDER BY BBRQ DESC LIMIT 2) t) GROUP BY BBRQ

cases.question: 当年资产处置收益中延期收款及重组收益是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(DNZCCZSYYQSKJCZSY) AS v FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1')

cases.question: 各机构各业务分类的逾期金额是多少？

cases.question: 本年投放金额高于各机构平均水平的机构有哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT JGMC, SUM(BNTFJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY JGMC HAVING v > (SELECT SUM(BNTFJE) / COUNT(DISTINCT JGMC) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1'))

cases.question: 存在逾期项目的机构，本年投放金额合计是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(BNTFJE) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') AND JGMC IN (SELECT JGMC FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SFYQ = '是' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1'))

cases.question: 收购处置类中累计投放金额最高的单笔业务是哪个项目？

cases.question: 期末成本余额高于各一级分类平均水平的分类有哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT YJFL, SUM(CBEY) AS v FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY YJFL HAVING v > (SELECT SUM(CBEY) / COUNT(DISTINCT YJFL) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1'))

cases.question: 没有逾期记录的机构，累计投放金额合计是多少？

cases.question: 当年投资收益高于各机构平均水平的机构有哪些（财务口径）？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT JGMC, SUM(DNTZSY) AS v FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND JGMC IS NOT NULL AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY JGMC HAVING v > (SELECT SUM(DNTZSY) / COUNT(DISTINCT JGMC) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND JGMC IS NOT NULL AND SJRQ = (SELECT MAX(SJRQ) FROM fct_jc_financial_stat WHERE BB = '1'))

cases.question: 逾期项目数最多的机构是哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT JGMC, COUNT(DISTINCT XMBH) AS v FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SFYQ = '是' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY JGMC HAVING v = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT XMBH) AS cnt FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1' AND SFYQ = '是' AND BBRQ = (SELECT MAX(BBRQ) FROM fct_jc_main_biz_stat WHERE BB = '1') GROUP BY JGMC) t)
